results.name: Participant Login & Team Data Isolation
results.scenario: Authenticate separate participant teams; verify T01 is forbidden from viewing T02 portfolio
results.expected: HTTP 200 logins, HTTP 403 on cross-team portfolio inspection
results.actual: T01 Login: true, T02 Login: true, Cross-Team Blocked: 403

results.name: Market Catalog Search, Instrument Details & Portfolio Visibility
results.scenario: Query full 2,854 security universe, search TCS, inspect private team multi-currency wallet
results.expected: Universe >= 2849 items, search returns matches in < 150ms, private wallet accessible
results.actual: Catalog Count: 2854, Matches: 2, Search Latency: 171ms, Wallet Accessible: true

results.name: Paper Order-Slip Creation & Duplicate-Ticket Rejection
results.scenario: Submit valid physical order slip; submit duplicate slip with identical ticket number
results.expected: First slip HTTP 200 (PENDING status); duplicate slip HTTP 400 Duplicate Ticket Number
results.actual: Slip 1: 200, Slip 2 Duplicate: 400 ("Duplicate Ticket Number: Physical Ticket #TKT-SLIP-P8-1793204081391 has already been logged into the queue.")

results.name: Verification Desk Claim, Validation & Approval
results.scenario: Officer claims order slip, verifies physical signature/tick size, marks verified
results.expected: Status transitions from PENDING -> BEING_VERIFIED -> VERIFIED_AWAITING_EXCHANGE
results.actual: Claim Status: BEING_VERIFIED, Verified Status: VERIFIED_AWAITING_EXCHANGE, Elapsed: 148ms

results.name: Exchange Desk Claim & Execution
results.scenario: Operator claims verified slip, executes trade, credits team holdings and debits cash
results.expected: Status transitions from UNDER_EXCHANGE_REVIEW -> VALIDATED -> EXECUTED with transaction record
results.actual: Execution Status: EXECUTED, TxId: TX0001, Latency: 265ms

results.name: Bank Settlement & Rejection Workflows (Two-Phase Mode)
results.scenario: Settle payment voucher confirmed at bank; reject voucher and release reserved funds
results.expected: Voucher 1 transitions to SETTLED; Voucher 2 transitions to REJECTED and releases cash reservation

results.name: Authorized SEBI Supervision & Trade Voiding
results.scenario: SEBI monitors transaction ledger and executes regulatory trade voiding with full reversal
results.expected: HTTP 200, transaction marked voided=true, audit reason recorded, cash and holdings restored
results.actual: Void Success: true, Voided Tx: TX0004

results.name: Projector Display Privacy & Public Market Updates
results.scenario: Big-screen display streams real-time index levels without leaking credentials or private team balances
results.expected: HTTP 200 with market indices, zero leaked PINs, zero private cash balances exposed
results.actual: Accessible: true, Indices Present: true, Leak Check: true

results.name: Wi-Fi Interruption, Reconnection & State Catch-Up
results.scenario: Disconnect client socket, execute trade on floor, reconnect socket, verify immediate catch-up
results.expected: Socket reconnects within 1500ms, immediately receives full STATE_UPDATE containing outage trade
results.actual: Reconnected: true, Outage Trade Synced: true, Reconnect Latency: 409ms

results.name: Operator Handover to a Spare Laptop
results.scenario: Primary laptop battery dies; operator authenticates on spare machine and processes pending order
results.expected: HTTP 200 login on spare machine, queue accessed, order executed without data loss
results.actual: Spare Login: true, Executed on Spare: true

results.name: Invalid Lot, Insufficient Funds & Negative Cash Guards
results.scenario: Reject order violating lot size multiples; reject order exceeding unreserved cash balance
results.expected: Lot size rejected with HTTP 400; Overdraft rejected with HTTP 400 Insufficient Funds
results.actual: Lot Blocked: true (Status: 400), Funds Blocked: true (Status: 400)

evidence.lotError: Order quantity 150 must be a valid multiple of lot size 100 for 600893.
evidence.fundsError: Insufficient unreserved INR balance. Required: ₹26,78,44,97,321.55, available: ₹99,65,180.15.

results.name: Final Ledger Reconciliation Across All 10 Supported Currencies
results.scenario: Inspect end-of-rehearsal ledger reconciliation report across all 10 core workbook currencies
results.expected: Bank reconciliation status HEALTHY, 0 ledger discrepancies, all 10 currencies tracked, totalCapital positive
results.actual: Status: HEALTHY, Discrepancies: 0, Currencies Tracked: 12, Capital: ₹1,54,93,20,000

results.name: Controlled Server Restart & Genuine Filesystem Recovery
results.endpoint: Controlled SIGTERM + Re-spawn on Same Fixture
results.scenario: Kill server process, restart pointing to same fixture, verify 100% of orders, transactions, and wallets survive
results.expected: Pre-shutdown orders and transactions equal post-restart orders and transactions with zero loss

results.name: Authoritative state.json Byte-for-Byte Hash Preservation
results.scenario: Confirm authoritative state.json was completely protected from mutations during rehearsal
